scenes.title: The Jasmine Morning
scenes.story_section: Every morning, before the rest of the house woke up, Lakshmi would open the wooden back door.
scenes.narrative_summary: Lakshmi begins her quiet morning before the house wakes.

image_asset.description: Lakshmi opening the back door in the morning

scenes.title: The Brass Pot
scenes.story_section: She kept a small brass pot beside the door and filled it only halfway.
scenes.narrative_summary: Lakshmi carefully carries a small amount of water.

image_asset.description: The small brass pot used for watering

hints.text: Remember the door where the morning began.

scenes.title: Toward the Jasmine Plant
scenes.story_section: She would carry the pot with both hands and walk toward the jasmine plant.
scenes.narrative_summary: Lakshmi carries the pot toward the jasmine plant.

image_asset.description: Lakshmi walking toward the jasmine plant

scenes.title: Picking Open Flowers
scenes.story_section: She never plucked the flowers that were still closed. She would wait for the ones that had opened during the night.
scenes.narrative_summary: Lakshmi gently picks the jasmine flowers that opened overnight.

image_asset.description: Lakshmi picking open jasmine flowers

scenes.title: Sorting the Flowers
scenes.story_section: She would separate the flowers from the leaves.
scenes.narrative_summary: Lakshmi sorts flowers from leaves beside the plant.

image_asset.description: Jasmine flowers being separated from leaves

scenes.title: The White Thread
scenes.story_section: She would take a long white thread from the little metal box near the window and wet it slightly.
scenes.narrative_summary: Lakshmi prepares the white thread for the flowers.

image_asset.description: Lakshmi preparing thread for the jasmine

scenes.title: Making the Garland
scenes.story_section: She would push each jasmine flower onto the needle and make a long string of jasmine.
scenes.narrative_summary: Lakshmi patiently strings the jasmine flowers together.

image_asset.description: Lakshmi making a jasmine garland

scenes.title: The Smell of Morning
scenes.story_section: One garland was for the small prayer room. One was for her daughter's hair. The entire house would smell of jasmine.
scenes.narrative_summary: The finished jasmine garlands fill the house with the smell of morning.

image_asset.description: Finished jasmine garlands at home

scenes.title: The Mango Tree
scenes.story_section: During summer holidays, Lakshmi would wake before her father. He would bring mangoes home in a large cloth bag.
scenes.narrative_summary: During summer holidays, Lakshmi notices the mangoes her father brought home.

image_asset.description: Mangoes arriving in a cloth bag

questions.prompt: What did her father put on the mango?
What did her father give Lakshmi?

hints.text: Look for the fruit from summer.

scenes.title: The Largest Mango
scenes.story_section: She would inspect every mango and always choose the largest one.
scenes.narrative_summary: Lakshmi chooses the largest mango and checks whether it is soft.

image_asset.description: Lakshmi choosing the largest mango

scenes.title: Running to the Tree
scenes.story_section: She would take it outside and run toward the mango tree behind the house.
scenes.narrative_summary: Lakshmi carries the mango toward the tree behind the house.

image_asset.description: Lakshmi running toward the mango tree

scenes.title: Climbing Up
scenes.story_section: She put one foot against the lowest part of the trunk and pulled herself up to a particular branch.
scenes.narrative_summary: Lakshmi climbs to the branch where she likes to sit.

image_asset.description: Lakshmi climbing the mango tree

scenes.title: The First Bite
scenes.story_section: She would sit on the branch with the mango in her lap, wipe it on her dress, and bite into the skin.
scenes.narrative_summary: Lakshmi eats the mango on her favorite branch.

image_asset.description: Lakshmi eating a mango in the tree

scenes.title: Her Father Finds Her
scenes.story_section: Sometimes her father would find her. He would pretend to be angry, then climb up after her.
scenes.narrative_summary: Lakshmi's father finds her in the tree and climbs after her.

image_asset.description: Lakshmi's father finding her in the tree

scenes.title: Salt and Chilli
scenes.story_section: He would cut the mango with his small pocket knife and sprinkle salt and chilli powder over the pieces.
scenes.narrative_summary: Her father cuts the mango and seasons the pieces.

image_asset.description: Her father cutting and seasoning the mango

scenes.title: The Largest Piece
scenes.story_section: Then he would give her the largest piece.
scenes.narrative_summary: Lakshmi receives the largest piece of mango from her father.

image_asset.description: Lakshmi receiving the largest mango piece

scenes.title: The Rainy-Day Kitchen
scenes.story_section: When the monsoon arrived, Lakshmi's mother would change the rhythm of the house. Lakshmi would sit near the kitchen door and watch the rain.
scenes.narrative_summary: Rain changes the house, and Lakshmi watches from the kitchen door.

image_asset.description: The monsoon arriving at the house

scenes.title: The Iron Pan
scenes.story_section: Her mother would place a large iron pan on the stove. First came the oil.
scenes.narrative_summary: Lakshmi's mother begins cooking with oil in an iron pan.

scenes.title: The Crackle

scenes.title: Come Back From the Stove
scenes.story_section: Lakshmi would move closer. 'Don't come so close,' her mother would say. Lakshmi would move back.

image_asset.description: Lakshmi's mother warning her near the stove

scenes.title: Peeling Garlic
scenes.story_section: Her mother would cut onions. Lakshmi would peel garlic one clove at a time.
scenes.narrative_summary: Lakshmi peels garlic carefully on the wooden board.

image_asset.description: Lakshmi peeling garlic on a wooden board

scenes.title: The Smell of Garlic
scenes.story_section: Sometimes she would crush more garlic than necessary just because she liked the smell.
scenes.narrative_summary: Lakshmi enjoys the smell of garlic while helping in the kitchen.

image_asset.description: Lakshmi enjoying the smell of garlic

scenes.title: A Little Portion
scenes.story_section: When the food was ready, her mother would place a little portion into a small steel bowl, blow on it, and give it to Lakshmi.
scenes.narrative_summary: Lakshmi's mother cools a small portion for her to taste.

image_asset.description: Lakshmi tasting food from a small steel bowl

scenes.title: Adjusting the Salt
scenes.story_section: Lakshmi always knew whether more salt was needed. Her mother would add exactly what Lakshmi suggested.
scenes.narrative_summary: Lakshmi tastes the food and helps decide whether it needs more salt.

image_asset.description: Salt being adjusted after Lakshmi tastes the food
